cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Raise the Impossibility
cards.instruction: Answer every strange offer with a more committed version that you can still justify.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've raised my hand too. Table for two in the air. Your flying chair needs a flying table; dinner should travel with the diner.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I was checking ceiling height. I can make the table circle the room.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Height checked. Add a hovering waiter; nobody should chase their soup.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The waiter can serve while flying upside down.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then commission gravity-proof soup. I won't make customers rotate between courses.

reason: A mistakes a ceiling measurement for joining an airborne dining order, then covers through increasingly committed restaurant requests. Preserve B's actual offers as the causes of waiter and soup choices.
